notes.title: Final Mission “Victory Flight” Added to Air Combat MF - Echoes of War
notes.notes:
To all players who own the base game Air Combat MF,

The final mission, “Victory Flight,” has been added to the free DLC Air Combat MF - Echoes of War.
In recognition of your achievements, you will perform a ceremonial victory flight.

[b][u]Weapons are disabled, so please fly along the designated flight path.[/u][/b]

We’ve also added the 15th Steam achievement for this mission, and a new track as an mp3 file in the DLC folder.

The story of Specter 1 reaches a milestone here.

notes.title: Free DLC Part 2
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3271600/Air_Combat_MF__Mini_TPS_Mission/

One of the XF fighter jet developers has been kidnapped by a mysterious organization!
Take control of the psychic Alice and use the gun and skills to rescue her.

[b]This DLC game is free.
If you choose not to participate in this TPS game, simply uncheck the DLC box in the Steam app.[/b]
This DLC game will be available for selection after release by pressing "Play" in the Steam app.

notes.title: Released
notes.notes:
The game and DLC have been released as scheduled.
The DLC, Air Combat MF - Echoes of War, currently has two missions.
If free missions are added in the future, an announcement will be made.
In the game, please use the A and D keys on the keyboard as well as the mouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35464197/3b0b294accf45727120cece252b3d0e986c7d9d4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Air Combat MF - Echoes of War
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3042420/

We have published the store page for the free DLC game, "Echoes of War."
This DLC can be launched as a standalone game when you press Play in the Steam app.
This DLC game is a sequel to the base game and currently has 2 missions.
You need 1500MB of storage to install this.
The DLC is installed automatically, but if you don't want it, you can turn off the DLC checkbox in the Steam app.
